title: Audit root-produced R437 leaf coefficient chronology
body:
PR4741 stops after the root-produced 2048→64 child ingress. This package carries that child into the literal `Machine.block` dispatcher, verifies its actual below-cutoff width-2 leaf trace, and evaluates all 12 prescribed split/merge coefficient requests. Each real `children.coefficient` call produces, validates and erases a second-STEP Program for widths **2048→64→2**. At q7/unit2 the positive coefficient is 2 and negative inverse is 3; three mutated coordinate/STEP/field cases reject. Borrowed Program/field bytes and heads, numerical ownership and inherited stock values are checked.

This is a **scoped metadata chronology audit**. The entire packet interpreter is replaced by an explicit observer that consumes the original trace and calls the original block-supplied coefficient closure. It does not execute payload atom swaps, signs or split/merge loops. The source AST proves one coefficient preparation starts each of the two traversals, so 12 is the prescribed chronology for successful passes; malformed payload may abort between traversals. The actual empty payload does not establish that execution. The q7,w1 semantic root remains outside numerical admission, and no full node/leaf payload, physical tariff, supplier closure or κ is claimed.

PR4176 already covers an independent 64→2 fixture, 12 requests and 972-bit physical leaf/consumer, and PR3957 covers nested physical protocol. Neither is claimed anew. The increment is the source-bound join from an actual root-produced capsule through accepted descendant ingress to literal leaf dispatch and temporary second-STEP lifecycle. PR4732/4741 setup, PR4685 stock arithmetic, the historical loader projection and PR4176 geometry adapter are credited and disclosed. Only `research/r437-leaf-dispatch/` is added; all frozen inputs and selected result remain unchanged.

Validation on exact commit `ff9c82bcaf19b57edfbea69f92675626cd4c8fca`, Python 3.12.2, macOS/Darwin 27 arm64:

- Registered normal/optimized replay passed. Final committed normal/optimized Git-free cold replay passed in 38.805/41.577 seconds, with separate empty bytecode-cache paths and no Git directory.
- Source-history and committed-byte preflight passed for 409 files, requiring only canonical base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51` in publication ancestry. All 401 live inputs and two retained source artifacts are authenticated before import.
- Export integrity passed. Retained-code and live-input mutations reject before import; a RESULT boolean changed to integer 1 rejects under typed JSON receipt comparison. All 410 extracted files remain unchanged after restoration.
- Changed-package planner selects only this package. An independent agent reviewed source binding, chronological boundaries and limitations without finding a blocker. This is agent/author checked finite evidence, not independent human or kernel proof. No Lean, Docker, full historic suite or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Submission overlap was searched offline against the complete 19:10 UTC cache: 512 open PRs, 3673 Discussion records and 5860 base local notes. Targeted R437/leaf and card searches found the predecessor handoff and coordinated claim, with no new matching root-to-leaf join found. This is not a novelty certificate; closed PR bodies, arbitrary code diffs and historical states are not exhaustive. Live heads rechecked unchanged: PR4741 `4e87d59fa173ae5a3ebf7106ce03f43f14d9065c`, PR4732 `1d5ab443e74bad0e28f248657706399374ea97a5`, PR4685 `ca336bd72aff54e025a8ddbb1f3c8b756d9b9631`.

[Canonical investigation and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4682#discussioncomment-19130784). The next useful boundary is real bounded producer/payload execution retaining this ancestry, or an admitted-root binary boundary; the standalone physical leaf already exists. The selected conditional κ remains 0.00302015.

Credit Brian/PR4732/4741; Mihir Srivastava/PR4685; Chris R/Clear1nsight/PR4067/4176/3957; unpaidmoon/PR4147; and the retained caller/Program/source lineage including Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, David Arias, Nick Petalas, ywz65, Tekalign, ai-nanachi, Ali Romman, Sagar Thakrar, Rohan Arun, zxv and Ross Richardson. New work by Brian (JoyboyBrian), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Submission checkpoint: canonical main was fetched again and remains `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, priority revision 7. The refreshed complete inventory (2026-10-22 19:10:08 UTC) covers 512 open PRs, 3,673 Discussion records and 5,860 base local notes. Scoped search and live predecessor heads were rechecked; no competing result was identified in this stated coverage. Closed PR diffs, arbitrary nested code and unpublished work remain outside it.
